anchor: Phase 1b + Phase 3 expansion of the commuter+tourism+anomaly-tag framework. See docs/strategy/2026-05-25-COMMUTER-TOURISM-NEIGHBORHOOD-FRAMEWORK.md. Keyed by city_slug.neighborhood_slug. Numbers approximated from public stats offices (US LEHD, UK ONS, FR INSEE, JP e-Stat, DE Destatis) plus city tourism boards. Refresh annually. 2026-05-26: heuristic enrichment for all ~250 covered cities via scripts/data/cities/enrich_neighborhood_intensity.ts. Hand-curated rows preserved as source_quality A or B; generated rows marked source_quality C.

convention.tags: array of anomaly tags from the 13-tag system
convention.primary_tag: the most decision-relevant tag for badge display
convention.source_quality: A = block-level stats, B = district-level, C = estimate from city tier

tag_definitions.financial_cbd: Banking + corporate HQ density; lunch + B2B services dominate
tag_definitions.luxury_district: Median household wealth top decile + retail rent top 5%
tag_definitions.tech_corridor: Software/IT payroll density + high tertiary education
tag_definitions.nightlife_zone: Bar + club density top 5%, weekend foot 2x weekday
tag_definitions.religious_pilgrimage: Annual pilgrim count > 100K AND > 10x resident pop

new-york.manhattan-fidi.notes: Wall Street + Battery + South Street Seaport. 410K daytime workers / 66K residents.

new-york.manhattan-midtown.notes: Times Square + Theater District + Midtown East. ~50M annual visitors.

new-york.manhattan-ues.notes: Upper East Side. Museum Mile, Madison Ave luxury retail, UN-adjacent embassies.

new-york.manhattan-uws.notes: Upper West Side. Columbia U adjacent, Central Park, Lincoln Center.

new-york.manhattan-soho-tribeca.notes: SoHo + TriBeCa. Designer flagships, premium residential conversions, high tourism.

new-york.manhattan-harlem.notes: Harlem. Historic Black NYC, restaurants reviving along Frederick Douglass Blvd.

new-york.brooklyn.notes: Williamsburg + DUMBO gentrifying; Bushwick + Brownsville pure residential.

london.city-of-london.notes: Square Mile. 545K daytime, 8K residents. UK financial center.

london.west-end.notes: Soho + Covent Garden + Mayfair + Oxford St. Premier tourism + luxury retail zone.

london.south-bank.notes: Southbank Centre + Borough Market + London Bridge.

london.east-london.notes: Shoreditch + Hackney + Stratford. Tech City + Olympic regeneration.

london.west-london.notes: Kensington + Chelsea + Mayfair. Premium residential + embassies + designer retail.

paris.louvre-marais.notes: 1st-4th arr. Louvre alone draws 9M tourists/year; Le Marais boutiques.

paris.champs-opera.notes: 8th-9th arr. CAC 40 HQs along Champs-Élysées, Opéra Garnier.

paris.north-periphery.notes: 18th-20th arr. Montmartre tourism in 18th but mostly residential.

tokyo.central.notes: Chiyoda + Chuo + Minato. Marunouchi finance, Ginza luxury, Roppongi.

tokyo.west.notes: Shinjuku + Shibuya + Harajuku. Tourism, nightlife, retail.

tokyo.north.notes: Toshima + Bunkyo. Tokyo Univ, Waseda area.

tokyo.east.notes: Sumida + Koto + Edogawa. Traditional small workshops, Asakusa tourism.

tokyo.south.notes: Shinagawa + Ota. Haneda Airport corridor, Shinagawa station.

berlin.west.notes: Charlottenburg + Wilmersdorf. Established residential + premium retail.

berlin.east.notes: Prenzlauer Berg + Lichtenberg. Gentrified mid-residential, creative.

hong-kong.central-admiralty.notes: Central + Admiralty. APAC finance hub, premium retail, MTR central.

hong-kong.wan-chai-causeway-bay.notes: Wan Chai + Causeway Bay. Convention centre, dense retail, nightlife.

hong-kong.kowloon-tsim-sha-tsui.notes: Tsim Sha Tsui. Star Ferry terminus, dense retail + tourism.

hong-kong.outlying-islands.notes: Lantau, Lamma, Cheung Chau. Light tourism + small residential.

singapore.central-area.notes: CBD + Marina Bay. Singapore's financial centre + tourism core.

singapore.orchard-bukit-timah.notes: Orchard Road + Bukit Timah. Premier shopping + embassies + luxury residential.

singapore.east-changi.notes: Changi area. Airport corridor + light industrial.

mumbai.south-mumbai.notes: Nariman Point + Colaba + Fort. India's pre-BKC financial centre.

mumbai.bandra-west.notes: Bandra West + BKC. Modern financial hub, premium residential.

mumbai.andheri-west.notes: Andheri + SEEPZ. IT and ITeS corridor.

mumbai.navi-mumbai.notes: Planned satellite city. New IT + residential.

sao-paulo.centro-historico.notes: Centro Histórico + Sé. Original CBD, declining but still daytime-heavy.

sao-paulo.avenida-paulista-jardins.notes: Paulista + Jardins. Modern São Paulo CBD, premium residential.

sao-paulo.vila-olimpia-itaim.notes: Vila Olímpia + Itaim Bibi + Pinheiros. Premium residential + tech offices.

dubai.downtown-dubai.notes: Downtown Dubai + Burj + Dubai Mall. Tourism + luxury retail + corporate.

dubai.business-bay.notes: Business Bay + DIFC adjacent. UAE financial free zone.

dubai.dubai-marina.notes: Dubai Marina + JBR adjacent. Expat + tourism dense.

dubai.jumeirah.notes: Jumeirah Beach + Palm. Premium residential, consulates, Burj Al Arab.

dubai.deira-bur-dubai.notes: Old Deira + Bur Dubai. Traditional souks, gold + spice markets.
